alt: The first page of manuals/copy.pdf (copy, copy.deepcopy, copy.replace and copy.Error) is converted to Markdown with docling on a GPU runner, then gpt-4o through instructor and LiteLLM fills a nested ModuleInfo with the Error class and the copy, deepcopy and replace functions; each manual becomes one row in coco_examples.modules_info, where array.pdf has 1 class, base64.pdf has 22 functions and copy.pdf has 1 class and 3 functions; editing copy.pdf updates only its row.
needs: OPENAI_API_KEY (or LLM_MODEL with its provider key)

run.note: Parse and extract the PDFs in manuals/

run.cmd: psql postgres://cocoindex:cocoindex@localhost/cocoindex -c "SELECT filename, title, num_classes, num_methods FROM coco_examples.modules_info;"
